component.name: Mailbox
component.summary: Mail, calendar, contacts, tasks and notes for the Linux desktop

description.p: Mailbox is a full personal-information client for the Linux desktop: mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, notes, a journal and RSS feeds, in one window with a classic ribbon.
It works with the servers you already have:

ul.li: IMAP, POP3 and SMTP mail, with OAuth 2.0 sign-in where a provider needs it
CalDAV and CardDAV for calendars and contacts across your devices
Client-side and server-side rules, junk filtering trained on your own marks, and search across every module
S/MIME and OpenPGP, remote-image blocking, and DKIM, SPF and DMARC results shown on the message
Four themes, a rebindable keyboard, and a customisable ribbon and toolbar

description.p: Your mail stays on your machine: one SQLite file per account, passwords in the desktop keyring, and nothing phones home unless you turn it on.
Screen-reader support across the application: the drawn lists, the modules, the dialogs and the ribbon speak their names, rows and states over AT-SPI.
Attachments, the DAV account wizard, older-mail paging and server search, backup and restore.
